title: (Updated) Microsoft Entra: Updated passkey registration experience in My Sign-ins
summary: Microsoft Entra is updating the passkey registration in My Sign-ins for Microsoft Authenticator users, adding a checkbox, updated link text, and guided steps to start registration. Rollout begins early December 2026, completing by end of December. Organizations should inform users and update guidance accordingly.
body:
Updated November 20, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

[What and why]

We’re updating the passkey registration experience in My Sign-ins for users registering a passkey in Microsoft Authenticator. Users will see an additional checkbox and updated link text, along with steps to guide users to open Microsoft Authenticator and select the + button to begin registration. If users can’t complete registration directly in Authenticator, the updated link text will help them find the WebAuthn registration flow.

[Rollout schedule]

- General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in early December 2026 (previously mid-November) and expected to complete by end of December 2026 (previously end-November 2027)[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Users who are guided through My Sign-ins to register a passkey in Microsoft AuthenticatorPlatforms and services

- Microsoft Entra My Sign-ins and Microsoft AuthenticatorWhat will happen

- Users will see an additional checkbox and updated link text during passkey registration.- Users will see steps to open Microsoft Authenticator and select the + button to begin registration:

- If users can’t complete registration directly in Authenticator, the updated link text will help them find the WebAuthn registration flow.[Action required and recommendations]

- Inform users about the updated UI and update your internal user guidance to reflect these changes.[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations were identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
